gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-modi: Bevellier's strokes all look cut from flat stencil stock at a single weight, with letters packed very close together. Noto Sans Modi's open curves leave the tight heading room to breathe.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Noto Sans Myanmar lays down a thick, heavy-looking strip of text, its c opening broad and welcoming. Bevellier's single-width stencil strokes above it feel lighter and far more graceful.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Noto Sans Nabataean reads generously, its lowercase standing almost cap-tall. Bevellier's joins stay as slim as a pipe cleaner, so its sophisticated, graceful look plays against that wide-open, tall-bodied text.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundar: Contemporary, Noto Sans Nag Mundari lets lowercase rival the capitals. Next to it, Bevellier feels sophisticated and graceful, every stroke drawn with one pen tip and the spacing tight.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-newa: Bevellier's crossbars are as fat as the stems they join, giving a flat, stencil-cut look to every letter. Bevellier handles display flair; Noto Sans Newa handles open, tall-bowled text.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Noto Sans Ogham has wide gaps in the e and tall bodies that make its lowercase look bold. And line after line, the bold, tall lowercase keeps going cleanly, while Bevellier shows no thick-thin flicker.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Noto Sans Ol Chiki holds the tails of its curves well back, so words read as solid blocks. Bevellier's near-zero stroke contrast joins it in a flat, graceful, solid texture.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: Bevellier cuts every letter flat like a stencil, with crossbars matching the stems in thickness and sidebearings pressed very close. Noto Sans Old Permic's rounded forms, open to the side, loosen it up.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdia: Noto Sans Old Sogdian's x-height nearly reaches cap height, and its wide-mouthed letters stay crisp when shrunk. Noto Sans Old Sogdian carries on readably paragraph after paragraph, while Bevellier's pipe-cleaner strokes stay slim and graceful above it.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Bevellier looks drawn with one pen tip, flat and stencil-cut. Noto Sans Palmyrene's curves stop short instead of closing in, and its compressed ascenders keep the whole pairing clean and modern.
